raw_name: precipitation much lower than potential evapotranspiration
quote:
Historically,
large-scale afforestation in areas where precipitation is much lower
than potential evapotranspiration has failed or shows signs of future
failure (Cao et al., 2010).

relationship.requirement: Large-scale afforestation is poorly suited where precipitation is much lower than potential evapotranspiration.
relationship.note: Direction is away from severe water deficit in P/PET, not proof of globally monotonic suitability. Much lower is not a quantified ratio, exclusion boundary or optimum.

context.practice_as_described: Active afforestation ecological restoration in arid/semiarid northern China; review cautions against woody planting where water balance cannot support forest. Region-specific conditional inference. Source published2011, online2010; no shift of historic source ID.
context.note: User-mandated T4 targeting gate passed. Qualitative regional siting evidence only; no numeric curve, global exclusion, implementation approval or effect extraction.

attribution: Cao, S., Wang, G., Chen, L. (2010). Questionable value of planting thirsty trees in dry regions. Nature 465,31. Cited in PDF5 of Cao et al. (2011); reference printed on same page. Primary not independently inspected.
